name: Trade Test
description: Integration test of trading on the rpg_plus game (its rpg_demo_game world): gathers brushwood, stones and a mushroom in the forest by walking onto them, heals the hero with the mushroom, talks to the village merchant whose dialog opens the trade window, sells the junk and buys an elixir by clicking the two inventories, checks that walking is blocked while the window is open and that Esc closes it. Activated by --itest=trade with --game=rpg_plus --new (the prologue is clicked through first); --shots=<dir> saves screenshots (windowed runs only).
